bindings.label: Patient presented to emergency department with severe back pain and later experienced episodes of light-headedness and chest pain
Medical history includes infective endocarditis and hepatitis C secondary to ongoing intravenous drug use
Recently underwent tricuspid valve replacement with a 29-mm bioprosthetic Carpentier-Edwards valve, complicated by transient third-degree heart block; pacemaker was placed two days before symptoms
Physical examination showed blood pressure 94/60 mm Hg and heart rates between 150 and 190 beats per minute
Transesophageal echocardiography reveals pulmonic valve vegetations
Transesophageal echocardiography reveals severe tricuspid regurgitation from a flail leaflet
Pulmonic valve infective endocarditis with severe tricuspid regurgitation
Septic shock secondary to infective endocarditis
